configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.description: 32-bit native Linux build (needs libsdl2-dev:i386). BUILD_STATIC links every package into one Game binary; appGetDllHandle resolves through the UNREAL_STATIC registry. Renderers: XOpenGLDrv and OpenGLDrv/UTGLR (system GL), NOpenGLESDrv, SoftDrv, NullDrv; NOpenGLESDrv and XOpenGLDrv co-link because Thirdparty/glad_es carries a private symbol prefix. The renderer forks are fetched by branch; point FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_XOPENGLDRV / FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_UTGLR / GL4ES_SOURCE_DIR at a local clone to build an unpushed change. Builds in build-native/.

configurePresets.name: native64
configurePresets.description: The 64-bit twin of native: the same one-binary package set, compiled for x86_64 (needs the amd64 libsdl2-dev). The shipped 32-bit .u packages run unchanged: script object references stay 4-byte object indices and the script-mirrored headers pack to 4. Builds in build-native64/.

configurePresets.name: android-arm64
configurePresets.displayName: Android arm64 -- the game as libHP2.so
configurePresets.description: The playable client as one shared library for arm64-v8a (SDL2 fetched and built shared beside it, openal-soft, libogg and libvorbis static, XOpenGLDrv on GLES 3, OpenGLDrv/UTGLR through gl4es and NOpenGLESDrv on GLES 2, SoftDrv, NullDrv): the same configure the Gradle project in Android/ runs, for a build without the APK. Needs ANDROID_NDK_HOME. Builds in build-android-arm64/.

configurePresets.name: wasm
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O2 with DWARF and assertions, the everyday dev build (named stacks, readable errors, playable speed). Needs EMSDK in the environment (source /home/ion/WorkUnreal/env.sh). Builds in build-wasm/.

configurePresets.name: wasm-debug
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build at -O0: nothing inlined, every local live. For when the optimiser is the suspect (a bug that shows at one -O level and not another is almost always undefined behaviour). Builds in build-wasm-debug/.

configurePresets.name: wasm-perf
configurePresets.description: Emscripten shipping build: compiled at -O2, linked at -O3 -g0 without assertions, plus a side symbol map. The build the frontend publishes. Builds in build-wasm-perf/.

configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.description: 32-bit Windows build, cross-compiled from Linux with the toolchain file (i686-w64-mingw32 and a fetched SDL2); the same preset works from an MSYS2 MINGW32 prompt. BUILD_STATIC links every package into the exe. Renderers: UTGLR (OpenGLDrv) and XOpenGLDrv through the system opengl32, SoftDrv, NullDrv; no NOpenGLESDrv (Windows has no OpenGL ES layer). Audio: NOpenALDrv with OpenAL Soft's OpenAL32.dll copied beside the exe. Builds in build-windows/.

configurePresets.name: windows64
configurePresets.description: The 64-bit twin of windows: x86_64-w64-mingw32 with the 64-bit SDL2 and OpenAL Soft builds (LLP64: long stays 4 bytes, pointers are 8). Builds in build-windows64/.
